# Technology stack

- Python 3.13.5; Django 5.2.4; SQLite by default.
- Function-based Django views, Django templates, static CSS and small vanilla JavaScript modules.
- Existing authentication, Firebase identity, compiler and resume features are retained.
- New interview content uses reviewed Python catalog data rather than a migration-backed model in this first release.
- Production settings now accept environment-based secret, debug, host, HTTPS, secure cookie, HSTS, and static-root configuration.
